premises.text: Without on-orbit refueling, satellites that exhaust their single tank of fuel are destroyed and their revenue is lost
premises.evidence_span: almost 200 satellites worth about 100 billion dollars have had to be destroyed because they've run out of fuel

premises.text: OrbitFab flies fuel tanks on available launchers and manages orbital logistics to deliver propellant when customers need it
premises.evidence_span: we manage the logistics and the orbital mechanics, and we deliver the right fuel to our customers when they need them

premises.text: A compact drop-in fueling port with tolerant self-aligning connectors enables safe high-pressure propellant transfer in orbit
premises.evidence_span: This fueling port has been built at a small size, a small weight, small cost, the same exactly as the fill ports that they currently use to fill up satellites on the ground

premises.text: Refueling lets satellite owners cut capital expenditure roughly in half while the service earns high gross margins
premises.evidence_span: customers can save 50 percent on their capital expenditure, and we take home gross margins of 90 percent

value.text: Stop throwing satellites away by refueling them so they continue earning for owners
value.evidence_span: it goes off to an orbit where it can make more money for its owners

causal_links.evidence_span: No system exists for safely and reliably fueling a satellite in space. So we set out to solve that problem first
refueled safely and reliably in orbit
save 50 percent on their capital expenditure

notes: Industry standard with 20 companies folded into drop-in adoption claim inside P3 rather than a separate premise. ISS demo and named contracts excluded as traction. Heinlein/solar-system line treated as vision. Singletons D1 and D3 retained.
